scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Major Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs) are giant magnetic clouds erupted from the Sun that trigger geomagnetic storms and cause radio blackouts.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: Strong solar storms cause electrical voltage fluctuations, requiring the disconnection of non-essential devices to protect main power breakers.
